jobs.title: AI & Data
jobs.description: We are looking for a passionate and motivated AI Intern to join our team. This is a great opportunity for final-year students or fresh graduates who want to gain hands-on experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI technologies.
requirements: Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field
Basic knowledge of Python, Machine Learning fundamentals, and APIs and REST services
Familiar with at least one: LLMs / Generative AI concepts, Azure OpenAI / AWS AI, LangChain or similar frameworks
Understanding of data handling (Pandas, NumPy)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Junior AI Engineer with 1 or 2 years of experience in AI systems automation and LLM integration. The role involves ingesting data, integrating with LLMs, and optimizing prompts.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
1+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development with Python
1+ years of experience in HTTP-based web development (REST APIs, Flask/Django)
1+ years working with LLM backends (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)

jobs.title: Data Science Intern
jobs.description: The graduate internship is a pre-hiring placement aimed at elevating the skillset of the candidates, providing them with an environment filled with learning and development in data science.
requirements: Bachelor’s or master’s degree
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
Entry level statistical knowledge
Adept in calculus and linear algebra
Basic knowledge of data engineering and Python
Basic understanding of supervised/unsupervised machine learning algorithms

jobs.title: Python Backend Developer Internship
jobs.description: Geek Labs is looking for fresh Computer Science graduates to join our Backend Developer internship. Interns will build complete websites and products using Python and Javascript.
requirements: Fresh Computer Science graduates
Good knowledge of backend system architecture
Proficiency using Python and the Django framework
Military service completed or exempt

jobs.title: Junior AI Automation Specialist (WhatsApp & Business Automation)
jobs.description: We are seeking an AI Automation Specialist to design and implement intelligent automation solutions for businesses, with a primary focus on WhatsApp-based automation systems and AI integrations.
requirements: 0-2 years of experience in automation and AI-driven workflows
Hands-on experience with one of the automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier, etc.)
Some knowledge working with REST APIs
Ability to work in a remote environment

jobs.title: C++ Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description: Atomica is seeking C++ Development interns to join our R&D team based in Cairo to help doctors provide patient care using AI, Robotics, and 3D Printing.
requirements: Fresh graduate or student in a relevant technical field
Good knowledge of C++ programming language
